messages:
alex: quick note — saw OOM attempts when serving long-seq traffic on v2 kernels. repro on canary.

rachel: which model / seq? any perf diffs?

alex: mix of open-llama-7b @ seq 2048. mem spike ~+2.3GB w/ logits scratchpad alloc.

sam: logs:
```
GPU0 total=16384MB used=14230MB timeline=alloc logits_scratch 2304MB
OOM at kv_attach() -> fallback_to_slow_kernel
p99: +28ms
```

luis: interesting — kernel selection is falling back because we can't allocate workspace for fused_logits. maybe workspace sizing math is conservative.

rachel: did we tune per-model workspace_limit? current default=512MB global.

alex: yup. PoC: enabled cross-request reuse and freelist compaction; memory dropped ~1.9GB and no fallback.

sam: results?

alex: p99 -22ms, throughput +6%, no OOMs across 1000 reqs. config snippet:
```
allocator:
  reuse_mode: cross-request
  eager_free_threshold: 0.15
  workspace_limit_mb: 768
  compaction_interval_s: 30
```

luis: nice. we should key pools by (model, quant, seq_bucket) so we don't mix tiny/huge allocations.

rachel: agree. also add a safety path: if kernel selection would choose fused kernel but workspace > free*0.8 -> try alternate kernel before allocating huge temp.

sam: can we simulate with surge? add a canary that throttles batcher to surface frag patterns.

alex: creating canary now. infra-bot: deploy canary v2-buffer-pool-test -> prod-00 with config above :rocket:

infra-bot: deploy triggered: canary v2-buffer-pool-test -> prod-00. rollout id: r-1900001

rachel: follow-up: add allocator telemetry tags: pool_key, orig_req_id, seq_len, kernel_chosen so we can trace why a reuse wasn't used.

luis: I'll add compact-on-demand in allocator: if free_small_blocks >= threshold and fragmentation_ratio > 0.3 -> run compaction.

alex: let's capture perf/regression test in eng-runtime perf job. if green, roll to dedicated canaries. cheers.
